text: weird. i restarted the program. it is the dev server, still dont see it
resolution: Fixed 'I restarted dev and still don't see the From-build-piece row'. Root cause was a DUPLICATE Studio: my req_1693/1684 UI edits landed in editors/model/Studio.tsx, but that monolith was superseded by the req_1390 side-by-side rebuild under editors/model/studiokit/, which is what the workbench actually mounts (source.tsx -> StudioEditor from studiokit/index). The live dialogs are studiokit/dialogs/AddShapeDialog.tsx + CompileAssetDialog.tsx (both 'lifted verbatim from Studio.tsx'). Ported both edits into the live copies: the 'From build piece' seed row (Wall/Half Wall/Window Wall/Floor/Stairs/Ramp via seedMeshFromPiece) and the Compile 'Placement' picker (Free/Railing/Wall panel/Trim -> buildPlacement). Verified by bundling studiokit/StudioViewport.tsx through the cart esbuild alias set (exit 0, clean). Also saved a memory (studiokit_is_live_studio) so this duplicate-copy trap doesn't recur, and noted Studio.tsx is now an inert demolition-candidate twin carrying the same change. Sha: e347ccd6b. User should hot-reload/restart dev hmsc-int to see it.
